prompt: Patrick is looking at a BIND 9 zone file and comes across a record of the format "`www IN A 192.168.1.5`". Which of the following describes this DNS record?
choices: It is a reverse record mapping `192.168.1.5` to the hostname "www".
It is an address record mapping the hostname "www" to IP address `192.168.1.5`.
It is a canonical name (alias) for `192.168.1.5`.
It is a mail exchange record for the www host.
explanation: An A record is an address record; "`www IN A 192.168.1.5`" maps the hostname `www` to the IPv4 address `192.168.1.5`.
